authorization: User authorized filling absent parameters on 2026-09-14 and expanding aggregate HB-DRAM capacity to 32 GiB on 2026-09-17
selection_rule: User-selected 2 GHz/Rconv=3 sensitivity; existing 1 GHz core dynamic coefficient scaled by physical f ratio at constant voltage, not to target temperature

thermal.status: MODELED geometry, interface assumptions and package boundary, not target process measurements
thermal.hb_pad_pattern: one cylindrical Cu pad per 3um square cell; includes all pads; no additional occupancy factor
thermal.hb_cu_kz_provenance: MODELED isotropic candidate only; 190 is NOT measured through-plane conductivity
thermal.hb_interface_provenance: Cu-Cu Rpp is AI baseline assumption; SiOx candidate uses the canonical reported upper bound as an explicit scenario value
thermal.cooling_provenance: MODELED 3 K/W sink-to-air sensitivity; V3.5 package boundary is unfrozen. Re-exported HotSpot RC, not old 1 K/W operator.
thermal.top_TIM_provenance: Inherited old top-package interface only. Old inter-die 20um TIM is NOT inserted into V3.5 hybrid bond.

power.status: MODELED inherited old baseline coefficients, not silicon calibration
power.leakage_temperature_dependence: MODELED constant baseline; explicitly no fitted temperature feedback
power.hb_energy: Read 0.88 pJ/bit directly from canonical V3.5, one charge per actual physical payload bit. With the fixed 96-block floorplan and no explicit HB power blocks, energy is assigned to the corresponding logic CORE endpoint; this placement is MODELED and total energy is unchanged.
power.dram_energy: Actual DRAMPower command calibration using newly instantiated V3.5 LPDDR5 timing and explicitly selected gem5 DDR5 current proxy
power.core_dynamic_frequency_provenance: DERIVED from MODELED 4 W per core at 1 GHz by Pdyn=CV²f; nominal 2 GHz full OPP is 8 W, voltage ratio 1.0.

activity_model.status: MODELED generic vector/reduction activity; GEMM activity is native NPUSim output
activity_model.contract: V3.5 vector/reduce lanes are FP32. For lowered tasks, only non-epilogue vector/reduction scalar ops are charged here. Native FP16 GEMM weights/operands are never re-counted from semantic bytes. Streaming terminal epilogues use the same FP32 rule inside native_plan events.

control.status: MODELED operating points and thresholds, not AMBER author hyperparameters
control.npu_sram_clock_policy: NPU compute and reserved compute-SRAM cycles track NPU OPP; DMA SRAM port, DRAM, HB and NoC have fixed independent clocks
control.refresh_switch_contract: new memory wave uses selected native refresh-state profile; in-flight wave finishes under issue-state profile; deferred nonpreemptive wave transition, not continuous command-state switching

timing.status: MODELED bridging decisions beyond canonical architecture
timing.hb_latency_provenance: Unknown; no fixed latency imposed. Native per-transaction HB reservations enforce canonical bandwidth.
timing.memory_hb_overlap: READ: native transaction completion then per-link HB reservation; WRITE: HB arrival before native submission; write data completion tail. No bulk HB post-addition.
timing.noc_zero_load_policy: Canonical 2-cycle links plus MODELED 1-cycle per-router pipeline; full-payload XY link reservation
timing.sram_reservation_policy: One macro output within workspace, drained before reuse.
timing.dram_native_timing_provenance: tCK=1.25 ns is the V3.5 Ramulator timing proxy. WRITE tail=13.75 ns is (WL=9 + BL/data_rate=2) * tCK from prepared/dram_power_proxy.json. Vector segment size is a MODELED command-stream chunk, not a sampling weight or drain barrier.
timing.prefetch_queue_provenance: MODELED two-entry task/data-ready queue per cluster; a waiting NoC transfer does not reserve the MAC array

experiment.status: MODELED sustained-throughput workload contract, not real robot arrival trace
experiment.request_cluster_placement_provenance: Capacity-correct placement: requests share one read-only resident weight layout and retain the task manifest's physical cluster. Request rotation is disabled because it otherwise implies unmodeled per-cluster weight replication or host-to-HB migration.
experiment.thermal_control_provenance: Uncontrolled Baseline. Reactive gating/DVFS is enabled only by an explicit protected/AMBER experiment; HiBAND and Baseline do not inherit it implicitly.
experiment.arrival_policy: Back-to-back cohorts; next cohort arrives after previous cohort and output traffic drain; no thermal or controller reset
experiment.scope: Cold cohort plus persistent-state long-run baseline DTM; NOT a completed AMBER comparison or Qwen run
experiment.request_semantics: 1/2/4 independent concurrent inference requests; each has 512-token prefill plus one decode
